reason: My clients have never asked for a walkthrough before the home is built, and I only do 1-6 homes a year. The architect already shows them the plans, so $1,500 a home is hard to justify.
objection: Our buyers have never asked for this before the home is built, and the architect handles the visuals already. I would be adding a cost line nobody requested.
would_change_my_mind: A few of my own clients asking to see their home in 3D before we break ground, or a per-plan price low enough to put a walkthrough on my website as a marketing piece.
